other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Jharkhand
Applicant must be a worker registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)
Applicant must have made continuous contributions for five years
Scheme is applicable for up to two children or female members of the family
Bride must be at least 18 years old
Groom must be at least 21 years old
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 for the marriage of up to two children or female family members.
